key_insight: Agent4FreeFem uses an LLM-driven, verification-guided workflow to turn natural-language topology optimization problems into verified results without manual solver-code development or debugging.
engineering_relevance: The framework could reduce expert effort in setting up and executing topology optimization for aerospace, automotive, and mechanical design.
method: Preserve the original problem definition throughout the automated workflow.
Localize errors using independent sources of evidence.
Apply constrained repairs automatically within stage-specific repair budgets.
evidence_signal: In the reported suite of single-physics and coupled multiphysics problems, every case passed runtime verification and completed within each stage’s repair budget.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify benchmark size or independently establish physical accuracy and optimization quality beyond runtime verification.
paper_title: Agent4FreeFem: A Verification-Guided Framework for Autonomous Topology Optimization
